name: Weston-super-Mare Open 2019
information: Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs above. **PLEASE NOTE:** For this competition, there will be a competitor limit of 24 *for Multi-Blind* on a first come first serve basis. If you register for Multi-Blind and are not within the first 24 people registered, your registration for the event will be removed. However we will be keeping a waiting list for this specific event in the case of dropouts either before the competition or on the day. Please only consider registering for this event if you are certain you would like to compete in it.
